geckoterminal.name: GeckoTerminal
geckoterminal.covers: DEX pools, prices, liquidity, the wallet behind each recent swap (Solana, Ethereum)
geckoterminal.history: last 300 swaps per pool (24 h); history is built forward by polling

solana_rpc.name: Solana public network
solana_rpc.covers: token supply, a wallet's token balance, top-20 holder accounts
solana_rpc.limit: rate-limited; the top-holder call is often refused

etherscan.name: Etherscan (free key)
etherscan.covers: Ethereum token transfers and wallet balances (other chains need a paid plan; holder lists are paid)
etherscan.last_error: Max calls per sec rate limit reached (3/sec)

binance.name: Binance public market data
binance.covers: exchange candles with taker buy volume (who hit the ask, not who they are), delisted coins' history

defillama.name: DefiLlama
defillama.covers: protocol TVL and fees (DeFi projects only)
